items.title: 61529_Maxine Sullivan oral history interview
items.q: I sang 'Summertime' and 'Nights Work If You Can Get It'... George Gershwin didn't write that there.

ctx.x: Do you still have that tape?

It's over at The House That Jazz Built somewhere. He also had a copy, he had a tape of the concert that I did at Lewiston Stadium, the George Gershwin Concert. I sang "Summertime" and "Nights Work If You Can Get It".
